LESSON: GUIDED WRITING (SENTENCE CONSTRUCTION)

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: GERMAN
Strand: Writing
Topic 3.5: Guided writing (Sentence Construction)
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 1

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Guided writing (Sentence Construction), part of Writing in Grade 6 GERMAN.

Key inquiry question: What do you do that shows you are careful when writing?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Guided writing (Sentence Construction) together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Communication and Collaboration: Learner develops the skill of writing sentences when s/he writes short texts about

likes and dislikes using appropriate language structure.

Values:
Unity: Learner demonstrates awareness for the value of cooperation and displays team spirit when s/he pantomimes

favourite activities in pairs/groups.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Peer pressure: Learner develops awareness for peer pressure as s/he indicates which activities s/he likes/dislikes

using Emojis/ thumbs-up/down.

Link to other Learning Areas: Learner links the expressions of likes and dislikes with the same concept in English.
